events.title: Heidelberg Materials Q3 Result, Revenue Rise; Backs FY26 View; Plans Addl. Cost Savings; Shares Up
events.description: Heidelberg Materials AG, a German building materials company, reported Wednesday higher result from current operations or RCO in its third quarter, driven by strong revenue growth, while RCO margin declined from last year. Citing the positive development over the past two quarters, the company confirmed its positive fiscal 2026 outlook.

events.title: German DAX Rises 1.29% On Lower Oil, Strong Earnings
events.description: German stocks climbed Wednesday morning, with the DAX benchmark gaining 335.08 points to 26,235.99, driven by lower oil prices, softening bond yields, and strong corporate earnings. Heidelberg Materials soared nearly 9% after raising its full-year outlook.

events.title: Indian Shares Extend Gains For Fifth Day
events.description: Indian shares closed higher on Wednesday, extending gains for a fifth consecutive session as softer oil prices eased inflation concerns and Democrats won full control of the U.S. Congress in a sweeping midterm rout, weighing on the U.S. dollar and Treasury yields.

events.title: Sweden Central Bank Hikes Key Rate By 25 Bps
events.description: Sweden's central bank raised its benchmark interest rate by a quarter-point as inflation is expected to continue rising going forward and hinted at further tightening in the coming year. The Executive Board of Riksbank decided to raise the key policy rate to 2.00 percent from 1.75 percent.

events.title: Australian Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Australian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday.

events.title: Gold Climbs As Dollar And Bond Yields Dip On The Democrat Midterms Victory
events.description: Gold prices jumped nearly 3 percent on Wednesday, driven by a softer dollar and lower Treasury yields after Democrats took control of both houses of Congress in a dramatic win in the U.S. midterm elections. Softer oil prices also helped ease inflation concerns.

events.title: Oil Prices Edge Lower In Choppy Trade
events.description: Oil prices traded lower on Wednesday after seeing sharp swings in the previous session amid uncertainty over the U.S.-Iran peace talks.

events.title: European Shares Rise On Solid Earnings
events.description: European stocks traded higher on Wednesday, with a slew of strong corporate earnings, steadier oil prices and lower bond yields helping underpin investor sentiment.

events.title: Asian Shares Mixed As Democrats Retake US Congress
events.description: Asian stocks ended mixed on Wednesday after Democrats took control of both houses of Congress in a dramatic win in the U.S. midterm elections, raising uncertainty over tech regulation, trade policy and the U.S. budget deficit.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Falls Following U.S. Midterms Elections
events.description: The U.S. dollar weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Wednesday, as early U.S. midterm election results increased political unpredictability.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Falls Against Majors
events.description: The U.S. dollar weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Wednesday.

events.title: European Shares Seen Lower As Investors Weigh US Policy Risks After Midterms
events.description: European stocks are seen opening notably lower on Wednesday after early results showcased significant gains for Democrats in the 2026 U.S. midterm elections, threatening President Donald Trump's legislative agenda and paving the way for new investigations into his administration's policies.

events.title: Indian Shares Edge Higher In Cautious Trade; US Election Results In Focus
events.description: Indian shares were modestly higher on Wednesday, extending gains for a fifth straight session as softer oil prices eased inflation concerns and early results showcased significant gains for Democrats in the 2026 U.S. midterm elections, weighing on the U.S. dollar and Treasury yields.
